observations: Photo 0 shows an indoor unit of a split air conditioner mounted on a wall. The brand 'Midea' is visible on the top left corner. The unit has a blue LED display showing '11'. A metal rod is hanging below the unit, possibly a part of the installation or a tool.

risks.proof: A video showing the unit running with cold air blowing, along with a close-up of the outdoor unit running and the refrigerant lines, would confirm functionality.

risks.risk: The unit may have been improperly installed or have damaged mounting brackets, which could affect performance or safety.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the indoor and outdoor unit mounting brackets, along with the refrigerant lines and electrical connections, would verify installation quality.

risks.risk: The 1.5hp claim may be false or misleading, and the actual cooling capacity may be different.
risks.proof: A photo of the model label or rating plate on either the indoor or outdoor unit, showing the exact model number and cooling capacity (in BTU or kW), would verify the 1.5hp claim.

proof_requests: Photo of the model label or rating plate on the indoor or outdoor unit to confirm the exact model and cooling capacity.
Video of the unit running with cold air blowing, including a view of the outdoor unit operating.
Close-up photos of the mounting brackets, refrigerant lines, and electrical connections to verify installation quality.
response.reason: The brand is confirmed as Midea, but the 1.5hp claim cannot be verified from the photos. The unit appears neat and functional, but critical risks such as actual cooling capacity, working condition, and installation quality cannot be confirmed without additional proof. The price cannot be determined accurately without verifying these factors.
